annotations.title: Can a provider serve a country under MiCA?

description: For one of the providers ChainChoice keeps a MiCA check page for and one country: whether ESMA's interim MiCA register, as ChainChoice last read it, lists the provider's entity for that EEA state (answer yes, no, not_applicable for a product outside MiCA's scope, or not_in_eea), why (home state, passport, Article 60 notification, ended, not yet in force, not listed, no entity), every entity that covers it with its LEI and authority, the register's read time and source, and the page anchor that prints the same cell. It is the register fact only: whether the provider's app accepts a reader also depends on its own terms. No ranking, score or paid link.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EL is read as Greece), e.g. "MT", or an EEA state's English name, e.g. "Malta".

provider.description: A provider id or name from ChainChoice's MiCA check pages, e.g. "bybit" or "Bybit".
